title: BetaClaudeTagSettings
description: Claude Tag settings. Without `include_inherited`, a setting that is null is not set on the settings level and is inherited. With it, `enabled` and `guest_policy` are never null, `instructions`, `model` and `environment_id` are null when no settings level sets them, and `reply_mode` is null unless the channel itself stores one.

enabled.description: Whether Claude is on. The nearest settings level that sets it decides.

instructions.description: Instructions for Claude. Instructions add up: the text of every settings level that sets it is joined, broadest first.

model.description: The model Claude uses: a model identifier or the name of a model line. The nearest settings level that sets it decides. When none does, Claude uses the product's default model.

environment_id.description: The environment Claude's sessions run in, starting with `env_`, or the identifier of a self-hosted runner pool, starting with `ccpool_`. The nearest settings level that sets it decides.

guest_policy.description: What Claude does in a channel while a Slack guest is in it. The nearest settings level that sets it decides.

reply_mode.description: How Claude takes part in the channel. Only a channel stores one, and no settings level passes one on, so it is always null on a workspace. Null on a channel means the channel stores none yet: Claude then follows the reply mode chosen in Slack, if one was, else `automatic`. A stored reply mode can be changed but never cleared.
